# New game, the system map, AUTO GATE into the ring, jump to ALTAAR.
# Starts on the title screen with a save present (CONTINUE first).
wait 2
tap down              # NEW GAME
wait 0.4
tap ok
wait 3
hold back 0.7
wait 0.8
tap down 5            # SYSTEM MAP
wait 0.4
tap ok
wait 2.5
tap down 3
wait 2.5
tap back              # back to the menu, cursor on SYSTEM MAP
wait 0.6
tap up 3              # TARGET
wait 0.4
tap right 3           # TRIX GATE
wait 1.2
tap down              # AUTO GATE
wait 0.6
tap ok
wait 12               # turn round and fly into the ring; the chart opens
wait 3
tap ok                # jump to ALTAAR
wait 7
